subject: DPA, UK addendum & TIA evidence — procurement cadence
messages:
From: Anna Carroll <anna.carroll@integrahealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA, UK addendum & TIA evidence — procurement cadence

Hi Michael / Logan —

Quick intro: I run vendor procurement for Integra Health. We are close to a legal review for Redwood, but legal needs a consolidated packet before we can route to finance. Two asks so we can queue the PO this week: 

1) Final DPA (with UK Addendum / IDTA language) we can redline — prefer a PDF we can attach to DocuSign.
2) Evidence bucket for the Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA / DTIA) — list of artifacts you will provide (SCC mapping, subprocessors performing cross-border processing, audit logs/escrow options, KMS/HSM attestation).

Also: a simple subprocessor inventory (CSV or table) with residency for each processor would be ideal. Can you confirm whether Redwood offers a procurement-friendly fallback (onshore-only residency or dedicated capacity) as a contractual option? Our security team will flag that if not available.

We have some bespoke requirements around retention for clinical PII — retention/encryption clauses need to be surfaced so legal can do quick redlines.

Attached: Integra_redlines.xlsx (procurement suggested clause numbers).

Proposed timeline: if we can get the DPA + evidence links by EOD Thursday (26 Aug), we will get legal review started and aim for DocuSign next week. Does that work?

Thanks,
Anna Carroll
Head of Vendor Procurement
Integra Health

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Anna Carroll <anna.carroll@integrahealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA, UK addendum & TIA evidence — procurement cadence

Hi Anna —

Thanks for the clear ask and the redlines. We can deliver the packet on the cadence you proposed. Summary of what I’m sending now (attached + links):

- redwood_dpa_v3.pdf — our standard DPA with UK Addendum (we usually propose a single DPA file that includes the SCC mapping appendix and the UK IDTA language inline).
- subprocessor_inventory.csv — canonical list of subprocessors with country of processing and whether they handle persistent storage, caching, or telemetry only.
- Drive folder (link below) with a scoped TIA checklist: expected artifacts we will provide within 5 business days after agreement signing.

Short answers to your questions: 
- Fallbacks: Redwood offers a Dedicated capacity option (reserved GPU pools) that can be contracted for onshore-only processing in supported regions; we can add language to the DPA to reference a residency SLA for the Dedicated offering.
- HSM/KMS: we support KMS integrations and can provide an HSM attestation for Dedicated and Private deployments; details in the attached DPA appendix.
- Retention: we propose a configurable retention clause — we’ll surface the default in the DPA and mark the clause for redlining.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-dpa-pack
DocuSign draft will be ready after commercial terms (we’ll coordinate PO# and signature order).

Attaching redwood_dpa_v3.pdf and subprocessor_inventory.csv. I’ll loop in Kimberly for technical evidence details and Laura for procurement cadence.

—Michael Grant
Director, Platform Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_dpa_v3.pdf (PDF), subprocessor_inventory.csv (CSV)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Anna Carroll <anna.carroll@integrahealth.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA, UK addendum & TIA evidence — procurement cadence

Hi Anna —

Following up with the technical artifact commitments we can include in the TIA evidence bucket. Short checklist (we will provide these items as separate files or attestations):

- SCC/UK Addendum mapping: per-processor mapping that shows which processing flows rely on SCCs vs. UK IDTA addendum. (we will supply a mapping CSV).
- Subprocessor roles: categorised (persistence, caching, telemetry, infra ops). For any subprocessors that touch tokenized or raw content we will add a short statement of purpose and residency.
- Audit logs: we provide request-level audit logs for Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted API will provide aggregated telemetry and request hashes on request (we can discuss level of granularity to avoid PII exposure).
- KV cache/export: if you need onshore-only KV caching, we support pinning to a Dedicated pool in region; will require a commercial addendum.
- Encryption & KMS: HSM attestation available (FIPS/HSM type and KMS vendor) for Dedicated and Private.
- Escrow / continuity: we can provide an export-of-customer-data runbook and sample retention deletion certs.

Timeline commitments: most artifacts (mapping, subprocessor statements, KMS attestation) = 3 business days after signature. Audit log extracts or escrow operations may take 5 business days depending on scope.

If Integra needs evidence packaged into a single ZIP for procurement/legal, we can do that. Please specify any strict redaction rules for clinical PII when we provide example logs.

—Kimberly Park
Lead, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Anna Carroll <anna.carroll@integrahealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA, UK addendum & TIA evidence — procurement cadence

Anna —

Quick procurement note from our side: to avoid signature delays we typically surface three items in the same DocuSign packet: (1) DPA w/ UK Addendum, (2) Master Services Agreement CE (commercial redlines), (3) SOW or order form that references Dedicated capacity (if you opt for onshore residency). 

Can you confirm: 
- Intended billing entity & PO# (so we include the correct payment clause),
- Single signatory for legal vs. a two-party signoff required by finance,
- Whether Integra will require a Residual Data Export clause beyond standard export/destruction language (some health customers ask for a retention carveout).

If we have the PO and signatory info by Mon 30 Aug we can route the DocuSign packet for signatures on Tue 31 Aug and aim to activate the Dedicated pool in the week after execution (subject to capacity).

Laura Bennett
Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Anna Carroll <anna.carroll@integrahealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Matthew Greenberg <matthew.greenberg@integrahealth.com>, procurement@integrahealth.com
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA, UK addendum & TIA evidence — procurement cadence

Thanks everyone — clear and helpful. We confirmed internally: 

- PO: INTEG-2027-0917 (will be sent tomorrow morning),
- Signatory: Matthew Greenberg (Legal) will be primary signatory, finance does not need separate signoff for this invoice band,
- Residual data clause: Integra requests a short residual data export addendum — please include language that allows for a machine-readable data export within 30 days of termination and a deletion certificate within 45 days.

We will upload our redlines (procurement_schedule.xlsx) to the Drive folder you shared and propose DocuSign routing to Matthew then Michael (signature order: Matthew -> Michael) on Tue 31 Aug. Please confirm you will include the Dedicated residency clause as an optional SOW attachment.

I’ll look out for the TIA artifact ZIP and the DocuSign packet.

Anna Carroll
Head of Vendor Procurement
Integra Health

Attachments: procurement_schedule.xlsx
